doctrine: Inspect live truth first, then build. Browser state never manufactures authority.

sensitive_rpc_posture.authenticated_execute: allowed only behind server-side scope checks

live_truth_anchor.rls_posture: RLS-enabled/no-policy tables are deny-by-default unless deliberately exposed through scoped RPCs; each exception requires documented proof.

release_blockers: no anonymous EXECUTE on authority-bearing RPCs
Admiral RPCs prove active server Admiral authority
Captain RPCs prove exact active vessel-Captain scope
Owner RPCs prove exact active project_owner scope
commissioning recovery binds durable voyage to authenticated actor
browser/session cache cannot promote server-safe state without Fleet Core read-back
change_policy: This package does not silently widen RLS or apply destructive database changes. Supporting-index migration is explicit and idempotent.
